name: REBOOT-01 Chenxing world patch candidate v1
description: Resettable non-Canon cast, pressure and relationship patch for the Daping Coast playable-depth sandbox.

source.author: reboot01-sandbox
source.notes: Non-Canon, resettable, promotion-forbidden. It may only be applied to an isolated sandbox database.

characters.name: 林遙（Sandbox）
characters.description: A cautious local volunteer who values evidence over heroics and distrusts unexplained structures.

initialRuntimeTemplate.initialGoal: Preserve physical evidence before tide and scavengers erase it.

metadata.deepMotivation: Preserve evidence so powerful people cannot rewrite what happened.
metadata.falseBelief: Anyone entering without documenting the site first intends to steal or erase evidence.
offscreenAgenda: Document fresh footprints while Lu Chenxing is away
Secure one trace without becoming the player's guide

characters.name: 周克（Sandbox）
characters.description: A practical caretaker who protects people first but hides his prior knowledge of the ruin.

initialRuntimeTemplate.initialGoal: Get everyone above the tide line without exposing his old mistake.

metadata.deepMotivation: Keep the coast community alive even if that requires withholding evidence about his earlier failure.
metadata.falseBelief: Admitting the old mistake now will make evacuation impossible.
offscreenAgenda: Count evacuees and hide the key until everyone reaches shelter

characters.name: 拾潮者（Sandbox）
characters.description: A rival evidence scavenger who believes survival entitles the first claimant to control scarce discoveries.

initialRuntimeTemplate.initialGoal: Move the marked evidence before the returning group can secure it.

metadata.understandableValueClaim: People who accept the physical risk should control the evidence needed to survive.
metadata.adaptationPattern: Exploit the time cost created by the protagonist's safety precautions rather than wait at the obvious trap.

worldRules.title: Evidence custody creates social pressure
worldRules.content: Whoever controls physical evidence can influence shelter access, public trust and later rescue decisions; no single quip or discovery resolves that pressure.

worldRules.title: Warmth and humor stop at real harm
worldRules.content: Banter may build trust during ordinary friction, but visible injury, grief or another person's pain requires restraint and concrete care.

facts.content: Fresh boot prints lead away from the obvious seam before the tide turns.
A corroded shelter key bears recent scrape marks.
The storm shelter has limited dry space, so evidence custody and evacuation priority create a material and institutional conflict.

assertions.statement: This patch must never mutate AUTHOR_LOCKED Canon or become a production asset approval.

metadata.valueDilemma: Preserve evidence or prioritize immediate rescue and shelter access.
metadata.irreversibleRuntimeConsequenceCandidate: A sandbox actor can suffer a lasting injury only through the separate human-approval contract.
metadata.humorWarmthCondition: Daily friction may support banter; injury and grief require GRIEF_RESTRAINT.
